reconstruction.scope: Original current exterior of three adjoining castle precincts: Palas/Kemenate/double chapel/Heidenturm,open inner court and forecourt with well/half-timbered ranges,Sinwell,Hasenburg and approach; Walburgis/Burgamtmann/Pentagonal Tower; Kaiserstallung and Luginsland with tiered dormers/corner oriels; northern/western bastions and gardens.
reconstruction.basis: Attributed original map coordinates; primary operator plan/photos and city guide read for forms and dimensions. No traced printed plan,photogrammetry,downloaded mesh or photo texture.
reconstruction.referenceState: Present exterior interpretation with reconstructed roofs and estimated apertures/vertical sections. Primary Sinwell height41m retained; other numeric heights,terrain plateau/stairs and current detailed site fit require review.
